title: A major iPhone supplier is trying to persuade investors that it's not about to be destroyed by Apple - but analysts are worried (AAPL)
text: A major iPhone supplier is trying to persuade investors that it's not about to be destroyed by Apple — but analysts are worried (AAPL) By Shona Ghosh May 10, 2018, 6:05 am 22 pts Chip designer Dialog Semiconductor said it has a "growing" relationship with Apple, after months of speculation that Apple could bring chip design in-house.
